dedupe_keys.name: simulated and synthetic data generation for interdependent natural gas and electrical power system based on graph theory and machine learning

description: Simulated and Synthetic Data Generation for Interdependent Natural Gas and Electrical Power System Based on Graph Theory and Machine Learning is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Zhaoyu Wang, Iowa State University (iastate.edu). The overall objective of this project is to apply recent advances in machine learning techniques and graph theory to investigate practical data-based approaches for producing simulated and synthetic datasets that faithfully represent interdependence between natural gas networks and power grids from mechanistic and human aspects. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-pwgy-fx23. Keywords: Power systems, Nature gas, Synthetic data, Test systems. Published 2019-06-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
